studies.title: Loss, And The One Exception
studies.meaning: An oath by time, and then a verdict on the whole species stated as a present condition: the human being is in loss, not heading toward it. Then one exception with four clauses, and the last two are reciprocal. Belief and good work are individual; counselling one another to truth and to patience cannot be done alone. So the exception, as stated, requires other people.
studies.historicalContext: Meccan, and one of the shortest surahs in the Quran. No specific occasion is reported. It belongs to a period when the community was small and under pressure, which is the situation the last two clauses describe: people holding each other to something. The word sworn by has been read as the age, as the passage of time, and as the late afternoon.

keyTerms.note: A root meaning to press or squeeze, as juice is pressed from fruit. The same word names the late afternoon and an era, and the classical readers record all three senses without choosing.
A trading word for capital that has gone down. It is indefinite here, so the sentence says a loss rather than the loss, and the tense makes the condition current rather than future.
A reciprocal verb, so each person is both the adviser and the advised. Repeating it twice, for truth and for patience, makes two separate mutual practices rather than one attitude.

studies.lifeInProphetsTime: Pressing was ordinary work: oil from olives, juice from dates, and the word for it came to mean the time of day when the sun is pressed toward the horizon. Arabic often builds abstractions from that kind of labour. Swearing by time in a language where the word for an era still smelled of a press gave the oath a physical weight the English cannot carry.
studies.didYouKnow: An early report describes two companions who, whenever they met, would not part until one had recited this surah to the other. It is three ayat long. A later scholar is quoted saying that if people considered nothing but this chapter it would be enough for them, and the remark has been repeated ever since.
studies.theologicalSignificance: Loss is set as the default, which reverses the usual assumption that a person starts neutral and accumulates a record. Everything after the exception is therefore not achievement but rescue. The two reciprocal clauses also make salvation partly social: whatever a person manages alone, the sentence as written requires them to be inside a relationship where truth and endurance are exchanged in both directions.

crossReferences.why: Uses the same reciprocal verb with a different second term, compassion in place of truth.
Uses the same verb of the opposite case, people passing an accusation down rather than a truth.
Runs the same shape, a verdict on the species and then one exception granted for conduct.

studies.applyIt: Ask one person this week to hold you to something specific, and be exact about what it is and when they should ask. Most people have nobody doing this. The surah's last two clauses describe a practice, not a feeling, and a practice needs a second person and a date.
